labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE, SANDBOXED, NO CHECKPOINT: EKA2L1 (the Symbian HLE emulator, our fork github.com/Wnt/EKA2L1 branch s80-integration, GPL-3) runs the Nokia 9300's own firmware 5.22 (RAE-6: Symbian OS 7.0s, Series 80 v2) inside a systemd-nspawn container (private PID/mount/net/user namespaces, host uid range 2621440+, rootfs --volatile=overlay, the EKA2L1 build and the golden data dir bound read-only, only work/ and the X socket dir writable, capabilities dropped, @mount filtered). Xvfb :119 at 1280x400 lives INSIDE the container; its root IS the 640x200 inner screen at exactly 2x (nokia9300-inner.sh resizes and moves the Qt window so the display widget sits at 0,0; the menubar and status bar hang off the root). The daemon captures the X root (SH_CAPTURE=x11) and types over XTEST (SH_INPUT_BACKEND=x11test, SH_X11TEST_KEYMAP=x11test.keysyms). No QEMU/QMP, no exec channel. Network = the retronet web plane (NOKIA_NET=retronet: the container runs inside netns rn-nokia9300 on vmbr-rn, static 10.99.0.43, DNS = the gateway, no default route) and Opera browses the archived web; docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-nokia9300.md. NO POINTER: the 9300 has none. KEYS per agent K1's keymap contract v1 (provisional until framebuffer proof): F1-F4 = the four command buttons beside the screen, F5-F12 = Desk / Telephone / Messaging / Web / Contacts / Documents / Calendar / My own, Menu, F13-F17 = joystick centre/up/down/left/right, ISO_Level3_Shift = Chr; printable characters as their own keysyms. Kiosk frontend (B2): the window is the root, ekactl/1 control socket at <station>/work/run/ekactl.sock. Reset=relaunch, in-process: `quit` on the ekactl socket (reset-tile.sh, the Restore button, the daemon's auto-reset); the container's inner loop relaunches EKA2L1 from a fresh copy of the golden data dir whenever it exits (~2 s), with no daemon restart. Drive it with xdotool on DISPLAY=:119 from labrun, or `labctl shot nokia9300`.

emulator.driver: RAE-6 (Nokia 9300), epoc7, firmware 5.22 SYM.ROM + Z: tree + the four Series 80 UI fonts; --run 0x101f8e4f (Desk) --kiosk --kiosk-home 0x101f8e4f --control-socket

network.note: Retronet web plane via a NETNS CAGE (the amigaos35 shape): EKA2L1's ESock is HLE (host sockets; RHostResolver::GetByName is the host's getaddrinfo()), so x11-runtime.sh (NOKIA_NET=retronet) starts the systemd-nspawn container inside netns rn-nokia9300 (nsenter --net; nspawn's own --network-namespace-path is refused under --private-users), whose only interface is the guest end of veth nokia9300rn0/nokia9300rn0g; the host end is enslaved to vmbr-rn (no uplink). Static 10.99.0.43 (reservation kept in RETRONET_DHCP_RESERVATIONS), MAC per the fleet scheme in gitignored local.env (RN_NOKIA9300_MAC), no default route in the netns and no CAP_NET_ADMIN in the container, fail-closed NOKIA9300RN-IN chain above RETRONET-IN. The netns resolv.conf (the gateway's wildcard DNS 10.99.0.2) is bound over the container's /etc/resolv.conf, so every name Opera types resolves to the gateway's seamless :80 door; config.yml hosts: stays empty and Opera needs no proxy. Containment proven from the emulator's own netns: 1.1.1.1 unroutable at the stack, 10.99.0.1 dropped, gateway DNS+HTTP answer; Opera on http://1.1.1.1/ shows 'System: Unspecified error'. See docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-nokia9300.md.

reset.mouse: N/A — the Nokia 9300 has no pointing device and no touchscreen; the exhibit publishes no pointer (stream.pointer.present=false).
reset.keyboard: PASS (2026-09-25, daemon path) — keymap contract v3 (agent K1: the ROM's own EKDATA tables translate every key in the fork). Through the real SPA in Chrome -> streamhost x11test -> XTEST on the dark rig: F7 opened Messaging (Inbox/Outbox/Drafts/Sent; the one-time "Cannot find message storage" note closes with Enter), F6 opened the Telephone directory, F10 opened Documents, "Nokia 9300 test 123" typed with correct case and digits, F8 opened Web on the Nokia home page, F5 brought Desk back (frames in the D2 bake report). Pacing 0/0 (agent K3: any nonzero dwell reorders Shift edges). The daemon resolves all 108 scancodes of the station keymap; the container's Xvfb carries F13-F17 and the contract's EuroSign/sterling/Nordic keysyms through a patched -xkbdir. Not framebuffer-proven on the station: Menu hold (task list, unhandled in EKA2L1), Chr combinations.
reset.fixture: Desk, the Series 80 v2 shell, as firmware 5.22 draws it in EKA2L1 s80-integration @ 4ef4b2fb6: the date header, the Personal / Office / Media / Tools groups, Clock and Nokia.com, the status pane (skin, clock, no-network and battery indicators) at the lower left, command buttons Open / Write note / Note list, in the Series 80 sans UI font, at exactly 2x in a 1280x400 root (B2's kiosk window). resetMode=relaunch, in-process: reset-tile.sh sends `quit` on EKA2L1's ekactl/1 control socket and the container's inner loop copies the golden data dir fresh and cold-starts Desk (~2 s to the relaunched emulator); the daemon and the visitor's stream stay up. The daemon also runs that reset 30 s after the last visitor left or after 10 min with no input (SH_AUTO_RESET_*), if the guest saw input. The pane clock is Helsinki time (17:07 at 14:07 UTC) and the Desk header reads 'Friday 25th September 2026'.
